current.title: 31 States Introduce 134 AI Education Bills Targeting Student Data Privacy and Classroom Rules
current.summary: A surge of 2026 state legislation is placing guardrails around AI in schools, with bills banning student data from being used to train AI models, requiring human oversight for high-stakes decisions, and adding AI instruction to graduation standards.

current.title: Schools Worldwide Shift From AI Bans to Structured Deployment as UNESCO and EU Frameworks Take Hold
current.summary: A 2026 review finds schools globally have moved past the ban-or-allow debate, now deploying AI as a productivity layer for teachers and administrators guided by UNESCO's generative AI guidance and the EU AI Act's phased rollout.

current.title: Georgia and Mississippi Lead Push to Require AI Literacy Credits for High School Graduation
current.summary: Multiple states are mandating AI instruction as part of computer science graduation requirements, signaling a national push to build foundational AI literacy among K-12 students before they enter the workforce.
